title: OpenAI ki 1.25 trillion dollar valuation - aapke liye kya matlab
content:
One point two five TRILLION dollars.
Reports ke hisaab se OpenAI itni valuation pe paisa utha raha hai.
CNBC ne kal report kiya ki OpenAI ek funding round finalize kar raha hai.
Round size, up to thirty billion dollars. Valuation, one point two five trillion, pre-money.
Aur report ke hisaab se is round ko UAE ke investors lead kar rahe hain.
Ek baat clear kar doon. This is based on sources. It is not an official announcement yet.
Ab interesting part suniye.
Yahoo Finance, Bloomberg ko quote karte hue, bata raha hai ki pehle OpenAI one point five trillion ki valuation pe raise karna chahta tha.
Matlab target thoda neeche aaya hai.
Aur March mein OpenAI ne one hundred twenty two billion dollars raise kiye the, eight hundred fifty two billion ki valuation pe.
Toh target neeche kyun aaya?
Same report kehti hai ki Wall Street pe AI stocks gire hain, kyunki investors data center build-out aur companies ke debt ko lekar worried hain.
So the hype is still huge, but investors are asking harder questions now.
Lekin aap soch rahe honge, mujhe isse kya?
Main na investor hoon, na OpenAI mein kaam karta hoon.
Yahin pe asli baat hai.
Itna paisa mostly compute pe jaata hai. Chips, data centers, training.
Aur jab compute badhta hai, toh models aksar sasta aur fast hote jaate hain.
Just this week, OpenAI made its Decisions API generally available at ten cents per million input tokens.
Matlab jo cheez ek saal pehle mehngi lagti thi, wo ab ek chhoti app mein bhi chal sakti hai.
Toh is news ko use kaise karein?
Step one. Har mahine apne AI tools ki pricing page dekho, kyunki prices badalti rehti hain.
Step two. Jo idea pehle cost ki wajah se chhod diya tha, usko dobara calculate karo.
Maan lo aapne ek customer support bot ka idea chhoda tha kyunki har reply mehnga padta tha. Aaj wahi calculation alag aa sakti hai.
Step three. Ek provider pe poori tarah depend mat raho. Keep your code flexible so you can switch models.
Mera take simple hai.
Valuation headlines investors ke liye hain. Hum jaise logon ke liye asli signal hai sasta aur better AI.
Jo log is sasti intelligence se real problems solve karenge, wahi aage jaayenge.
Follow karo, roz ka AI update yahin milega.
